Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital Signs $150 Million Conditional Loan Commitment with Stoke Space Technologies, Inc.
items.summary: The War Department's Office of Strategic Capital announced a $150 million conditional loan commitment with Stoke Space Technologies, Inc., a U.S.-based space launch company developing fully reusable rockets, to provide low-cost, high-cadence access to orbit.

items.title: Joint Statement, USS Colorado (SSN 788) Announced as First Submarine for Submarine Rotational Force – West
items.summary: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth and Australian and U.K. counterparts announced the designation of the USS Colorado as the first U.S. Navy Virginia-class fast-attack submarine assigned to Submarine Rotational Force West, beginning in late 2027.

items.title: Greetings to the participants and guests of the Yury Ozerov International Military Film Festival
items.summary: Vladimir Putin sent greetings to the participants and guests of the 24 th Yury Ozerov International Military Film Festival, held in the Hero City of Tula.
